verdict.rationale: Docs describe streaming input mode as the 'preferred' interactive mode, ClaudeSDKClient for chat-like UIs, and hooks that fire on tool-call/session events, all of which support streaming tokens and intermediate events to a UI (claude-agent-sdk-docs-12, -13, -3, -22). However, hands-on community reports directly contradict the quality of this in practice, describing the default harness as 'completely garbage' at displaying tool call details with flashing/rescrolling UI and '0 observability', contrasting it with third-party harnesses that expose these events properly (claude-agent-sdk-comm-3, -4, -5). Missing for 10: independent corroboration that the default streaming UI reliably renders tool-call/step events without the reported rendering bugs, and clearer first-party examples of consuming intermediate events programmatically.
